title: You are where you eat tote
slide_intent: Let a carried object express a memorable belief so the brand travels through everyday use.
strategic_value: The phrase on a produce-filled tote can connect Sweetgreen’s identity with the places and food people choose.
demonstration: A hand holds a dark green tote filled with vegetables; large white serif words read You Are Where You Eat.
practical_value: Judge a short message at the scale and folds of a reusable bag.

content_islands.name: Tote message
content_islands.spec: Stack the white words on the bag’s broad face.

content_islands.name: Use context
content_islands.spec: Retain the hand, vegetables and outdoor background to show the object being carried.

reference_purposes.Application: The phrase is printed on a tote used to carry produce.
reference_purposes.Expression: Large white serif type contrasts with dark green fabric.
